text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Route53 health check flapping detected for service-edge pool in eu-west-1 (az-b) — 15% failed checks in 3m, triggering incident. Auto-create incident channel.
prod-monitor: seeing elevated 5xx from regional edge, spike started ~8:12 UTC, clients report slow/no responses from eu-west-1. Grafana: ELB error-rate + latency jump.
oncall-tilly: paging oncall (PD) — I'm on it. Jumping into #incidents.
oncall-tilly: quick summary: users in EU reporting timeouts, per-edge metrics show ELB 504s and increased connection resets. Route53 shows flapping between weighted pools to eu-west-1 and eu-central-1.
sre-jen: I can take net checks. Miguel, can you check infra control plane / ENI attachment errors in eu-west-1a/b? I suspect asymmetric egress.
infra-miguel: looking. AWS console: several ENI detach/attach events in eu-west-1b around 08:10. No EBS detach alerts. VPC flow logs show bursts of RST from host-level NICs.
support-liz: Customer impact: billing notifications, chat widgets, and some webhook callbacks failing. Tier 1 tickets already spiking. ETA to the rest of support: escalate to enterprise customers.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-45678, severity=P1 — responders: oncall-tilly, sre-jen, infra-miguel. Runbook link: <https://internal/runbooks/az-network-deg>
oncall-tilly: ok, plan: 1) triage scope 2) fail traffic to eu-central-1 for critical routes 3) coordinate AWS with assigned TAM if control plane unstable.
eng-lead-sam: +1 on failover. Recommend targeted weight shift in Route53; avoid full DNS TTL flush. We can shift 80% of traffic to eu-central-1 for the next 10m.
sre-jen: doing quick traceroutes and curl to ELB IPs:
```
traceroute -n 13.32.45.78
 1 10.0.0.1 0.4 ms
 2 10.10.0.1 1.2 ms
 3 52.30.11.4 8.6 ms
 4 34.220.10.1 30.2 ms
```
curl -v https://edge-eu-west1.redwood.ai/health
* Connected to 13.32.45.78 (13.32.45.78) port 443
> GET /health
< HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
```
infra-miguel: AWS API: describe-network-interfaces shows 6 ENIs in state 'reassigning' across eu-west-1b. Opening a support case. There's also a cloudtrail spike of "DetachNetworkInterface" events from auto-recovery.
oncall-tilly: immediate mitigation: shift Route53 weights. sam, can you make the change? Use weighted recordset 'edge-weighted' and reduce eu-west-1 weight to 20.
eng-lead-sam: doing it now. Pushing: console change + API to keep TTL low (60s) for the short window. Patch command:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"edge.redwood.ai","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"eu-west-1","Weight":20,"TTL":60,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"13.32.45.78"}]}}]}'
```
ops-bot: Route53 change submitted (ChangeInfo: C123456). propagation ~ 60s.
prod-monitor: after weight shift, 503/504 rate down from 14% -> 3% in 90s. Latency for EU clients trending back to baseline for eu-central-1.
support-liz: notifying impacted enterprise customers and posting status page update: "Partial degradation in eu-west-1; traffic shifted to eu-central-1. Investigating root cause."
oncall-tilly: good. Next: verify no degraded background jobs or delayed async tasks. Check queues and retry rates.
sre-jen: looking at SQS and backlog — retry queue saw a 2x bump but consumer throughput steady. No dropped messages.
infra-miguel: AWS case open, rep says control plane had a regional network fabric change causing transient ENI reassigns in eu-west-1b. They're rolling a patch, monitoring.
eng-lead-sam: suggestion: enable cross-zone ELB fallback for critical listeners and adjust healthcheck grace to 15s to avoid churning during in-region noise.
oncall-tilly: let's not change ELB config mid-incident unless necessary. For now, maintain weight shift. Miguel, watch for reconverge and when healthy, we'll ramp eu-west-1 back up in 10m increments.
ops-bot: PagerDuty: oncall-tilly acknowledged, second-level alert routed to sre-jen.
prod-monitor: FYI: CDN edge metrics show origin failures for eu-west-1 only; most client requests now served by eu-central-1. No data plane errors observed in other regions.
support-liz: support action items: 1) post status 2) triage open tickets for EU customers 3) send interim email to top 10 customers. Doing now.
infra-miguel: update from AWS: "We observed a control-plane scaling event affecting ENI lifecycle in eu-west-1b; mitigation in progress. Expected recovery 20-40 minutes." They've added an internal ticket and will notify when stabilized.
oncall-tilly: logging timeline & decisions in incident doc. Next check in 10m. If healthy, we'll ramp weights: 50% -> 80% -> 100% with 5m observation windows.
eng-lead-sam: after stabilization, propose postmortem to include: Route53 weighted failover runbook, ELB cross-zone fallback guidance, and alert thresholds tuned to detect ENI churn earlier.
sre-jen: capturing logs and saving traces for repros. Also recording an ELB-level dump for AWS case.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated (partial) — traffic shifted to eu-central-1, AWS remediation in progress.
oncall-tilly: handoff at +45m to second-shift. @sre-jen will take next watch; I'll update pagerduty shift and close timeline notes. Thanks all.
support-liz: posting final customer update: "Service degraded in eu-west-1 earlier; most traffic routed to eu-central-1. Full service expected to recover once AWS finishes remediation. We will follow up with timeline and RCA." :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-45678 updated: severity lowered to P2; closing notes pending postmortem.
oncall-tilly: closing the channel in 30m unless AWS notifies otherwise. Good job coordinating. :thumbsup:
